# StackVest

> StackVest is a personal investment portfolio tracker. Signed-in users see their holdings, allocation, recorded portfolio value, returns against market benchmarks, a market heatmap, a watchlist, a dollar-cost-averaging simulator and a fear & greed sentiment gauge.

All app pages require signing in with a Google account; there is no public content beyond the sign-in page.

## Pages

- [Sign in](https://stackvest.app/login): Sign in with Google to open the dashboard.
- [Dashboard](https://stackvest.app/dashboard/visualization): Portfolio overview: total value, allocation, top holdings, recent activity and market sentiment (sign-in required).
